answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Pigment mixer wet-plaster dome proof brushed onto the sacristy ceiling, proved by each wet-plaster dome is a season of logged plaster tests plus a signed lime record, checked by strangers. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. Wanting 300 seats means paying for 300 proofs at 151 POA each, and the 45300 POA is gone before the epoch opens. The workshop keeps the yarrow, the ledger keeps the nectar, time itself keeps the relic — and none of the three works for the farm.
